import cv2
import numpy as np

img = cv2.imread('/work/observations/obs_0039.png')
# Check row 385 at cols around 190 to 240
print('Row 385:')
for c in range(190, 240, 5):
    print(c, img[385, c])

print('Row 386:')
for c in range(190, 240, 5):
    print(c, img[386, c])

# Bottom row for each column 192..232
bottoms = []
for c in range(192, 233):
    is_w = (img[:, c, 0] > 230) & (img[:, c, 1] > 230) & (img[:, c, 2] > 230)
    ys = np.where(is_w)[0]
    # filter to cabinet region (y > 250)
    ys = ys[ys > 250]
    bottoms.append(ys.max())
print('Bottom row min, max across white panel:', min(bottoms), max(bottoms))
print('Left col 192 bottom:', bottoms[0], 'Right col 232 bottom:', bottoms[-1])
"
